text: I spot Ingot, Illydia and Willow by the bar. Ingot seems quite affected by something, I can tell by the way he appears to be downing a few drinks, as if he needs that liquid courage for something.
I decided to approach him.
Ingot. Ingot Gaylord. Strangely enough, he and Reid were the only two from our batch that had a last name.
He was only the one amongst us to ever get married and adopt a kid. His wife, Forged Lesbianlady, and daughter, Nugget Gaylord.
Honestly, I have no idea how Ingot ever managed to court Forged. Sure, he was incredibly charismatic but he was also incredibly stupid.
That was also probably why their relationship didn’t last.
Fursttryl: “Should one of Kingswood’s town guards be downing drinks like that?”
Ingot: “Firstly, I am currently off-duty. Secondly, I need it. My ex will be arriving at the funeral soon and I am going to have to use all the resources I need to face that shrew.”
Fursttryl: “Should one of Kingswood’s town guards be downing drinks like that?”

options.label: 1: Oh, speaking of which, how’s Nugget?
2: You shouldn’t be calling your ex wife that
3: Fair enough, want me to get you another round?

text: Fursttryl: “Oh, speaking of which, how’s Nugget? I haven’t seen the kid in a while”
Ingot: “Nugget? She’s doing great, growing up so fast already. I remember how tiny she used to be. Now, she’s even taller than her old man despite only being 12. Haha.”
Fursttryl: “Well, I mean, you’re like 4’’7, it’s that hard to be taller than you.”
Ingot: “Rich coming from the 4’’0 gnome.”
Fursttryl: “Touche.”
Fursttryl: “You shouldn’t be calling your ex wife that. That’s really disrespectful”
Ingot: “You were never married to her. You don’t know what she’s like. So I don’t want you lecturing me on something you know nothing about”
Fursttryl: “I’m just saying, she is still the mother of your child.”
Ingot: “Yeah, and some mother she is.”
Fursttryl: “Fair enough, want me to get you another round?”
Ingot: “Heh. Well well, maybe you’re not so bad after all, Fursttryl.”
Fursttryl: “Did you think I was bad? Maybe you don't deserve a free drink after all.”
Ingot: “Hey hey, relax now. You said it so no take backs.”
Fursttryl: “Fine…only because you need it for when your wife arrives.”
Ingot: “The only thing about my ex wife coming to the funeral that I’m looking forward to, is seeing Nugget”
Fursttryl: “Right. Since you only see your daughter on the weekend while your wife has her on weekdays.”
Ingot: “Ex-wife.”
Fursttryl: “Right. Ex-wife”
Ingot: “Anyways, I don’t want to think about that woman anymore until she actually gets here…you know what I think *you* don’t want to think about? You falling early. Haha”
Fursttryl: “Be quiet! That wasn’t my fault at all! The floor was strange, I swear”
Ingot: “You swear?”
Fursttryl: “I swear!”
Ingot: “Do you swear to Mamu?”
Fursttryl: “...”
Fursttryl: “That’s not fair.”
Ingot: “Sure it ain’t. You’re just upset that you got outsmarted by me of all people.”

options.label: 2: And you’re happy to outsmart me of all people?
3: Well, why didn’t you use that intelligence to win child custody over Nugget?

text: Fursttryl: “Spell “Library” then if you’re sooooo smart.”
Ingot: “I can do that. Easy. L - Y - B - E - R - R - Y.”
Fursttryl: “Not even close.”
Ingot: “Is it not?”
Fursttryl: “It really isn’t.”
Ingot: “Well you already knew I can’t even read.”
Fursttryl: “So I’m smarter.”
Ingot: “No.”
Fursttryl: “Yes.”
Fursttryl: “And you’re happy to outsmart me of all people? We’re basically equals in terms of intelligence.”
Ingot: “Hahaha, I guess you’re right. We’re both not the brightest so it’s basically the dumb outsmarting the dumber.”
Fursttryl: “I am NOT the dumber, excuse you!”
Ingot: “Fine. The dumb outsmarting the dumb. Happy?”
Fursttryl: “Happy.”
Fursttryl: “Well, why didn’t you use that intelligence to win child custody over Nugget?”
Ingot: “...what?”
Fursttryl: “You heard me, *genius*.”
Ingot: “See, you really are stupid. You’re lucky that we’re at a funeral right now and I don’t want to cause a scene from smashing my glass against the side of your empty skull.”
Fursttryl: “How scary.”
Ingot: “Well anyways, now that I think about it, I should probably stop drinking. Don’t want Nugget seeing me fully drunk. If you need me, I’m just going back to the main hall.”
